Description: Data measuring the level of transcriptional activity of genes, such as RNA-seq or microarray output.
Data measuring chromatin accessibility, modification, or regulatory activity, such as ATAC-seq or ChIP-seq output.
Data describing variation in DNA sequence relative to a reference genome, such as SNPs, indels, or structural variants.
Data generated by antibody-based assays measuring the presence or quantity of a target protein or biomarker.
Data describing relationships or interactions between biological entities, represented as a graph/network structure.
Data consisting of raw or processed DNA/RNA sequence records.
Data consisting of image files, such as microscopy or radiology images.
